$description: Birdy type styles. The reviewed source for Figma text styles and the generated CSS classes in Code/src/styles/type.generated.css. Groups: display (content names in Bricolage), heading (interface structure in Instrument Sans), body (reading text), label (controls and chips). Each field names a Primitives token: family → font/family/*, size → font/size/*, weight → font/weight/*, lineHeight → font/line-height/*, letterSpacing → font/letter-spacing/*. Style names match the Figma text style names; the CSS class is .bd-type-<name with / replaced by ->. See foundations-audit.md.

display/page.usage: Page titles (PageHeader, sign-in). One per page.

display/panel.usage: Title of a docked panel or drawer, such as the task panel.

display/section.usage: Dialog titles, welcome headings, document h2.

display/card.usage: Names and headings on cards and tiles (projects, teams, focus card).

heading/md.usage: Interface headers at body size: Card header, popover and panel headers, empty-state titles.

heading/sm.usage: Sub-section titles inside panels, dialogs, groups and board columns.

heading/overline.usage: Group labels in navigation, menus and the command palette only.

body/lg.usage: Large input text, such as the command palette search field.

body/md.usage: Default body text and input values. Set on body.

body/md-compact.usage: Body text that wraps inside a tight row: activity and notification sentences.

body/sm.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, hints, list metadata, breadcrumbs.

body/sm-compact.usage: Secondary text that wraps inside a tight row: notification excerpts.

body/caption.usage: Counts, timestamps, shortcuts and other small metadata.

label/md.usage: Labels on md controls (Button md). Single line only.

label/sm.usage: Labels on sm controls, form field labels, segmented control, chips. Single line only.

label/xs.usage: Badges and table column headers. Single line only.

label/mono.usage: Keyboard shortcuts (Kbd) and other short code-like labels. Single line only.
